2026_02_LV_LAC.headline: Bowers and McConkey uncertainty puts complementary weapons under the spotlight in Los Angeles
2026_02_LV_LAC.paragraph1: Las Vegas enters the AFC West matchup with Brock Bowers doubtful, forcing the Raiders to prepare for a major redistribution of targets and blocking responsibility. The Chargers have their own uncertainty with Ladd McConkey questionable, while Elijah Molden and Trey Pipkins III are out. Las Vegas needs Ashton Jeanty and its remaining receivers to keep the offense balanced; Los Angeles must protect consistently and rediscover passing rhythm after a subdued opener against Arizona.
2026_02_LV_LAC.model_rationale: Skill-position availability, replacement production and protection quality should determine which offense can sustain drives rather than relying on isolated explosive plays to create scoring chances.
